## Publication

**Authors:** Sophal Chan, Kwankamon Dittakan, Matias Garcia-Constantino  
**Venue:** *International Journal on Advanced Science, Engineering and Information Technology*, Vol. 10, No. 6, pp. 2189–2199, Dec. 2020

## Background of the Study

Knee osteoarthritis (OA) affects millions in Thailand; early X-ray-based detection can guide prevention when recovery from advanced OA is limited.

## Motivation of the Study

Compare texture descriptors across anatomical ROIs (medial/lateral femur and tibia) to find the most reliable automated OA vs. non-OA classifier.

## Key Result

**Lateral Femur + Local Binary Pattern → AUC = 0.912** (131 images: 68 OA, 63 non-OA).
